title: Pioneer Venus Large Probe on Venus

height.product: Venus Magellan Global Topography 4641m v2 (GTDR altimetry)

color.product: Venus Magellan SAR left-look global mosaic 75m (FMAP)

note: Large (Sounder) Probe touchdown 1978-12-09 at 4.4 N, 304 E (NSSDCA 1978-078D). Colour is Magellan radar brightness (roughness), not visible light; the real ground is lit dim orange under thick clouds. Height is ~4.6 km/px altimetry upsampled to a ~98 m grid, so it only shows broad slopes. Projection: local tangent plane, north up. Coordinates are the NSSDCA-listed touchdown points; the probes were not tracked to the ground precisely, so the site is approximate (tens of km).
gravity_note: Venus's gravity is 91% of Earth's, but the air is 90 times thicker and hot enough (465 C) to melt lead.
